title: Sequence-based Prediction of the Cellular Toxicity Associated with Amyloid Aggregation within Protein Condensates.
authors: Horvath, Attila; Vendruscolo, Michele; Fuxreiter, Monika
one_liner_zh: 该文基于TDP-43深度测序数据，在液滴景观框架下分析突变对无序蛋白凝聚体成熟为淀粉样聚集体及细胞毒性的影响，并扩展FuzDrop方法实现基于序列的毒性预测，直接涉及IDR/相分离介导的互作机制建模。
abstract: Various neurological dysfunctions are associated with cytotoxic amyloid-containing aggregates formed through the irreversible maturation of protein condensates generated by phase separation. Here, we investigate the amino acid code for this cytotoxicity using TDP-43 deep-sequencing data. Within the droplet landscape framework, we analyze the impact of mutations in the amyloid core, aggregation hot-spot, and droplet-promoting residues on TDP-43 cytotoxicity. Our analysis suggests that TDP-43 mutations associated with low cytotoxicity moderately decrease the probability of droplet formation while increasing the probability of multimodal binding. These mutations promote both ordered and disordered binding modes, thus facilitating the conversion between the droplet and amyloid states. Based on this understanding, we develop an extension of the FuzDrop method for the sequence-based prediction of the cytotoxicity of aging condensates and test it over 20,000 TDP-43 variants. Our analysis provides insight into the amino acid code that regulates the cytotoxicity associated with the maturation of liquid-like condensates into amyloid-containing aggregates, suggesting that, at least in the case of TDP-43, mutations that promote aggregation tend to decrease cytotoxicity, while those that promote droplet formation tend to increase cytotoxicity.
abstract_zh: 多种神经功能障碍与含有细胞毒性淀粉样蛋白的聚集体相关，这些聚集体通过相分离 (phase separation) 产生的蛋白质凝聚体不可逆成熟形成。在此，我们利用TDP-43深度测序数据研究这种细胞毒性的氨基酸编码。在液滴景观框架内，我们分析了淀粉样核心、聚集热点和促进液滴形成的残基突变对TDP-43细胞毒性的影响。我们的分析表明，与低细胞毒性相关的TDP-43突变适度降低了液滴形成的概率，同时增加了多模态结合的概率。这些突变促进了有序和无序结合模式，从而促进了液滴与淀粉样状态之间的转换。基于这一理解，我们开发了FuzDrop方法的扩展，用于基于序列预测老化凝聚体的细胞毒性，并在超过20,000个TDP-43变体上进行了测试。我们的分析提供了对调控液滴状凝聚体成熟为含淀粉样蛋白聚集体相关细胞毒性的氨基酸编码的见解，表明至少在TDP-43的情况下，促进聚集的突变倾向于降低细胞毒性，而促进液滴形成的突变倾向于增加细胞毒性。
